[BATCH NOTE b033] Batch b033 covers lines 113–390 of reports/configuration-audit-2026-03-25.md (batch b032 covers lines 1–112); no claim in this file begins before line 113. This is the superseded v1 audit of 2026-03-25 — values are extracted as this document asserts them, at its own lines; corrections made by the v2 audit of the same date are NOT imported, and no value here is marked 'historical' on the strength of another document contradicting it. Explicit scope decisions under hard rule 5 (logged, not silent): check identifiers ('1:', '2:', '3:', '1,5:', 'Check 5'), erratum ids (E40, E42), session numbers (Session 56, Session 57), the 2026-03-25 date, instruction-hash prefixes (2518d529…, ded339c9…, 81c3485d…), and numbers inside directory/condition/config names (pv-diag-384, tiles_384, -n5, -n30-t07, h9-A-p1/run_1) are not extracted. Corpus-wide counts in this document derive from a filesystem census of outputs/, not from a committed JSON artefact: where the scanned subtree still exists (outputs/h11, outputs/retest, outputs/retest/phase3c/track1-image, outputs/h11/proposer-verifier-384) the claim is anchored recompute-script to that subtree; where it does not, the claim is anchor-unknown.
